hints.text: The upper quartile is the median of the upper half, the four largest values in this set.
The upper half is $\{5, 6, 7, 8\}$. Its two middle values are $6$ and $7$, so compute $(6 + 7) \div 2$.

explanation: The $8$ ordered values split into two halves, and the upper half is $\{5, 6, 7, 8\}$.
$Q_3$ is the median of the upper half, which has two middle values, $6$ and $7$.
Average them: $(6 + 7) \div 2 = 6.5$, so the upper quartile is $Q_3 = 6.5$.

steps: $Q_3$ should split the upper half $5, 6, 7, 8$ into two equal parts, so test $6.5$.
The values $5$ and $6$ are below $6.5$, and the values $7$ and $8$ are above it.
Two on each side within the upper half confirms $Q_3 = 6.5$.
